subject: general
question: What is the main purpose of using a file compression technique before uploading to cloud storage?

options.text: To reduce the file size and save storage space
To make the file readable across different devices
To convert the file into a secure format

solution:
The correct answer is __**To reduce the file size and save storage space**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
 

• **File compression** is a technique used to reduce the size of a file by encoding its data more efficiently. This is crucial for saving storage space, especially when dealing with cloud storage services. 

• Uploading compressed files requires less **bandwidth** compared to larger uncompressed files, which makes the process faster and more efficient. 

• Many cloud storage providers, such as **Google Drive** and **Dropbox**, charge fees based on the amount of storage used. By compressing files, users can store more data within the same storage limit, saving costs. 

• File compression can also improve the **data transfer speed**. Smaller files take less time to upload and download, improving user experience and efficiency.
